profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI-Augmented Development | Java & Spring Boot | AWS | Developer Productivity
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm a seasoned Full Stack Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience with a passion for software development. Hands-on extensive experience building, testing, and maintaining software systems in multiple technologies; migrating mission-critical business software applications to the cloud following Microservices Architecture. Recently worked on a migration effort to modernize a business' software application ecosystem written in multiple legacy technologies such as JAVA, J2EE, legacy spring framework, tomcat, and Angular, and successfully migrated to the Azure Cloud using modern frameworks like Spring Boot, increasing reliability by three times and applications' performance by 60%, plus using automation DevOps toolchains such as Azure Pipelines and GitHub Actions automated the development and delivery of software maximizing productivity and optimizing the development speed. By combining my passion for software development and skillset in multiple programming technologies, I continue to build software that impacts people.

Feel free to check out GitHub found in the Contact Info.

Skills: JAVA, Typescript, Spring Framework (Spring Boot), Hibernate, Spring MVC, Selenium, Splunk, Grafana, IBM Cloud, IBM WebSphere, Serenity Framework (BDD), JUnit, Mockito, Test Driven Development (TDD), Microservices Architecture, Agile Methodology, Angular, J2EE, Tomcat, Docker, Kubernetes, Legacy Migration, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, DevOps, Azure DevOps, Automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owed the observability implementation for critical backend application using Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog providing visibility on AWS containerized environments.

• Developed the customer banking front-end application using ReactJS, published in AWS Cloud, impacting the engagement of new clients to enroll in customer bank products.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated critical enterprise-level business applications written in multiple legacy technologies (Java, J2EE, Legacy Spring) and successfully migrating to Azure Cloud with cutting-edge technologies such as Spring Framework, Docker, Containerization, Kubernetes, following Microservices Architecture, increasing applications’ performance by 200% and saving $20000 in yearly costs.
• Owned the implementation of DevOps processes with modern automation tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps boosting development processes and team delivery speed by 80%.
• Enriched system metrics by integrating telemetry with Grafana; facilitating monitoring, and alerting by correlating APIs and client application logs, providing insight into business transactions visible to the business team through visually rich dashboards decreasing the time of failure to 10 minutes from an average of 1 hour.
• Led the development of a new enterprise-level Single Page Application (SPA) based on Angular E2E collaborating with several cross-functional teams (sales, refunds, design team), improving user experience and increasing transaction flow speed by 60%.
• Mentored software development teams performing extensive knowledge transfer to the teams on software development best practices, testing methodologies, and team culture adaptation, reducing the on-boarding process to ¼ of the time required.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Spring Framework · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) · GitHub · RESTful WebServices · Web Development · JavaScript · Github actions · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Spring MVC · Back-End Web Development · Test Driven Development · Microsoft Azure · Git · Java · Test Automation · Spring Cloud · Spring Boot · Agile Application Development · Microservices · Agile Methodologies · Spring Webflux · Azure DevOps · Spring Security

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
• Responsible for the development of large number of applications E2E from identifying requirements, implementation and development, testing to delivery, whose usability extended critical business applications.

• Designed and developed SOAP web services and rest APIs around Mainframe store procedures to integrate with proprietary applications, modernizing backend system and increasing its resiliency by 90% and aiding company improvement in sale processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · XML · Spring Framework · RESTful WebServices · Java

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designer and developer of a test drive scheduling application using Ionic Framework for Porsche Dealership Puerto Rico, increasing the volume of clients.

• Oversaw development for the initiative to bring affordable Point of Sales (POS) solution with Odoo to company’s clients, impacting 20% of company’s small business owners.

positions.description: Created a mobile application end-to-end using Ionic Framework for non-profit organizations, increasing volunteering, community work and non-profit organizations’ effectiveness.
